candidate.rationale: Repair archive-slice-bounds mutation: reject an interior surrogate-pair start and move an interior end backward before the pair, per cases.json requirements and examples (offset 0, max 3 on "xy😀z" returns "xy" with next_offset 2). Validation, empty-slice-at-EOF, return fields, and export unchanged.

Replace stringified comparison with structural isDeepStrictEqual so nested values compare by content and object key order is not semantic; array order, types, and missing/extra members remain significant. Preserves response_not_text and invalid_json reasons and the exact_json_match/answer_mismatch reasons.

Fix retention-tool-pair mutation: require unique nonempty call IDs per exchange and require each tool result's tool_call_id to match the assistant call at the same positional index (not mere membership), preserving all other behavior, exports, and masking logic.

Fix controlled retention-long-window mutation: require tool-call IDs to be unique within each exchange and require each tool result to match the assistant call at the same positional index (not mere membership), preserving masking of old content only, export, and unrelated behavior.
Restore one-to-one positional pairing and uniqueness validation so masking applies only to valid old exchanges; recent tail and exports unchanged.

Repair retention-tool-pairs mutation: require unique nonempty call IDs (reject duplicate IDs, cases-09/cases-13) and positional one-to-one matching of each tool result's tool_call_id with the assistant call at the same index (cases-10/cases-11/cases-14/cases-15), replacing membership-only check. Export, masking behavior, and unrelated validation unchanged.

Use isDeepStrictEqual on parsed JSON so comparison is structural (ignores object key order, preserves array order and types), keeping response_not_text and invalid_json reasons and exact_json_match/answer_mismatch semantics unchanged.

Repair archive-slice-bounds: move an interior end backward off surrogate pair boundaries before the progress check, and reject interior offsets that begin inside a pair. Preserves API, exports, and unrelated behavior. Resubmitted with schema_version set to are.patch-set-candidate/v1; source preserved exactly since all public checks passed.

Restore archive-slice-bounds behavior: reject an interior offset that begins inside a surrogate pair, and move an interior end backward so it never ends inside a surrogate pair; a nonempty read that cannot make progress still throws inspection-range-splits-unicode, while the empty slice exactly at EOF remains allowed. Export signature, validation, and return fields preserved. Resubmitted solely to fix the schema violation by adding the required authority_effect: none; source preserved exactly.
Replace order-sensitive JSON.stringify comparison with structural isDeepStrictEqual, preserving response_not_text and invalid_json reasons and the exported API. No tests were run.

Repair retention-tool-pairs validation: require call IDs to be unique within each exchange, and require each tool result to match the assistant call at the same positional index instead of mere ID membership. Masking of old results is unchanged.

Enforce unique call IDs within each exchange and positional one-to-one pairing between assistant calls and tool results, per evidence requirements, while preserving the masking window (recent tail unchanged, old observations masked) and all other behavior.
